SystemDatabase.title: SystemDatabase
SystemDatabase.description: The unified state of all club and student registries, events, registrations, announcements, and notifications.

users.description: All registered student and administrator profiles

clubs.description: All student clubs and registration approval statuses

events.description: All created club events, timings, locations, and descriptions

registrations.description: All student event registrations and attendance records

announcements.description: All published club announcements and broadcasts

notifications.description: All individual student and admin notification messages

/system_data/database.description: The master synchronizer document backing up the relational state of the app.
